summary: This YAML configuration sets up Behat testing with Chrome browser automation. It enables a custom Chrome extension for Behat and configures the Mink extension to run tests against a local Chrome instance, using the Avonture website as the base URL for test navigation.

explanations.3: This loads a custom Chrome extension class that provides Behat with Chrome-specific testing capabilities.
explanations.4: Behat's Mink extension is a browser automation layer that lets tests interact with web pages like a real user would.
explanations.5: The browser_name tells Mink to use Chrome as the browser for running tests.
explanations.6: The base_url is the website that tests will navigate to; all relative links in tests will be based on this domain.
explanations.10: The api_url points to ChromeDriver, a service that runs on your machine and controls the Chrome browser remotely. Port 9222 is Chrome's default debugging port.
